name: HR Seats Angular with Apache Proxy
postStartCommand: sudo bash -c 'if [ ! -f /etc/ssl/private/desk.services.siag.it.key ]; then mkdir -p /etc/ssl/certs /etc/ssl/private && openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout /etc/ssl/private/desk.services.siag.it.key -out /etc/ssl/certs/desk.services.siag.it.crt -subj "/C=IT/ST=Italy/L=Milan/O=SIAG/CN=desk.services.siag.it" && chmod 600 /etc/ssl/private/desk.services.siag.it.key && chmod 644 /etc/ssl/certs/desk.services.siag.it.crt; fi && service apache2 start'
